name: Skill Enchanting
description: System allowing players to enchant active and passive skills using Skill Enchantment points, Adena, and Spellbook absorption experience up to +3.

class_skill_examples.effect: Makes feature conditions easier to deal with, amplifies effect
Increases P. Atk, Max HP, P. Skill Crit Rate, and power of additional triggered attack

rewards.skill_power_boost: Varies by skill tier and enchant level

notes: Requires 3rd class transfer. In Aden Arena Season 1 (Lv 1-40), this mechanic is marked [SEASON 1 OUT OF SCOPE] for base progression, but provides structural design reference for future skill mastery tiers.

name: NEW STAGE Aden Laboratory
description: Facility enabling players to invest Adena into systemic stat research across 4 progressive research tiers.

tiers.special_effect: Bonus effect when Queen Ant's Ring is equipped
Bonus effect when Orfen's Earring is equipped [PARTIAL DATA]
Bonus effect with Core/Baium epic jewels [PARTIAL DATA]

notes: [SEASON 1 OUT OF SCOPE] for Aden Arena Lv 1-40 gameplay, serves as endgame Adena sink reference.

name: Hidden Power
description: System where up to 4 hidden power bonuses can be unlocked and selected across 16 possible stats using Dye Potential.

facts.unlock_condition: Expanded Potential of Dyes required for the 4th bonus slot

notes: [SEASON 1 OUT OF SCOPE] for Lv 1-40, but informs the architecture of secondary passive allocation.

name: Guardians System
description: 9 specialized combat creatures assisting the player with unique active and passive skills, equipment items, leveling, and evolution.

common_skills: Guardian's Gratitude - Common Craft (Increases craft charge)
Guardian's Gratitude - Magic Lamp (Increases magic lamp charge rate)
facts.weapon_affinity: Each guardian has weapon type affinity granting bonus buffs when player equips matching weapon type, or debuff when non-matching

requirements.summoning_item: Specific Guardian summoning item or Atingo drop

notes: Guardians bridge combat and passive crafting/lamp efficiency.

name: Equipment Set System
description: Synergy mechanic activating tiered set bonuses when equipping matching pieces of Armor sets (Helmets, Upper, Lower, Gloves, Boots).

bonus_types: P. Def / M. Def percentage boost

notes: Core mechanic directly applicable to Aden Arena D-Grade and C-Grade armor sets (Brigandine, Reinforced Leather, Knowledge, Composite, Demon, etc.).

name: Equipment Sealing (Security)
description: Anti-theft mechanism where items are stamped with a Security Seal to prevent transfer or trade if unauthorized access occurs.

facts.monthly_limit: 50 pcs per month reset every 30 days at 06:30 UTC+3
facts.effect: Item becomes non-tradable and non-droppable until unsealed

notes: Distinct from classic Blacksmith Unsealing of dropped B/A grade armors.

name: Armor Unsealing (Blacksmith)
description: Classic mechanic where dropped or crafted B-grade and A-grade armor pieces drop as (Sealed) and must be unsealed at town Blacksmiths.

facts.service_npc: Blacksmith NPCs in town (excluding starter villages)
facts.unsealing_cost: Adena fee scaling by item rank and grade
facts.resealing: Blacksmiths can re-seal armor pieces if player wants to change set variant

notes: [SEASON 1 OUT OF SCOPE] for Lv 1-40 (D/C grade are not sealed), but relevant when B-grade is introduced.

name: World Trade
description: Asynchronous marketplace permitting trade of items between players across servers.

facts.retrieval_deadline: 120 days for unsold items and claimed earnings

notes: Provides definitive economic benchmarks: 5% sales tax, 14-day duration, 10 slot cap.

name: Class Change
description: Special service enabling characters with 3rd class change completed to switch to another class archetype while preserving progress.

facts.skill_retention: Returned skill books are sealed and account-locked, only saved for skills learned under modern rules

notes: [SEASON 1 OUT OF SCOPE] for Lv 1-40, provides structural insight into class lineage.

name: Collections
description: Account-wide permanent stat repository where registering specific combinations of equipment, consumables, or cards permanently bestows cumulative stat bonuses.

facts.permanence: Items registered into the collection are permanently consumed
stat_categories: Max HP / Max MP / Max CP
P. Skill / M. Skill Critical Damage
P. Skill / M. Skill Critical Rate
CON / MEN / STR / INT / DEX / WIT

requirements.required_items: Specific items with designated enchant levels

notes: Major gear sink that keeps lower-grade items (No-Grade, D-Grade, C-Grade) valuable indefinitely in the economy.

name: Experience & Level Progression
description: Standard mathematical curve governing character experience requirements from Level 1 up to Level 100+.
notes: Direct mathematical bedrock for Aden Arena Season 1 (Levels 1–40).

name: Daily Missions & Magic Lamp
description: Daily mission system rewarding active monster extermination and daily logins with EXP, Adena, and Magic Lamps.

facts.magic_lamp_mechanic: Earns separate Magic Lamp EXP from mob kills; upon 100% fill, grants a Magic Lamp roll awarding Red, Blue, Green, or Purple EXP/SP jackpot

notes: Core retention loop directly portable to Aden Arena idle loops.
